body: Meet  Jan Van,  a custom camper van meticulously crafted for our esteemed customer, designed to blend style, comfort, and functionality. This bespoke van conversion boasts a robust 400W solar system and an 800Ah Lithium Iron Battery, ensuring Jan Van is powered up for all off-grid living adventures. The 3000W pure sine wave power inverter/charger and multiple 110v electrical outlets, including those for a microwave and Starlink, make this van a mobile powerhouse. Plus, with a 30A shore power plugin and a 50Amp DC-DC/solar charger combo, Jan Van is always ready for any journey.

The Jan Van features a luxurious kitchen setup, perfect for the culinary enthusiast. The acacia butcher block countertop and fold-down table offer ample space for meal prep and dining. With an in-counter double burner induction cooktop and Isotherm Cruise 130 refrigerator with a freezer, this kitchen is equipped for gourmet meals on the go. The stainless steel sink, complete with a Zuvo water purification unit, ensures clean water for all needs, while the 700W built-in microwave is perfect for quick, convenient meals.

Comfort in any climate is paramount in Jan Van. Equipped with a Maxxair Deluxe ceiling vent fan and a 12v Roof Mounted Nomadic A/C unit, the van stays cool during the summer. In colder months, the Espar gasoline-powered cabin heater provides cozy warmth. Our premium insulation package, featuring Havelock wool and insulated PEX lines, guarantees a comfortable environment year-round. The rear door outdoor shower and Laveo Dry Flush Toilet add convenience, making Jan Van as functional as it is stylish.

The interior of Jan Van exudes charm and practicality. Painted shiplap siding, a wood-stained ceiling, and vinyl wood-style flooring create a warm, inviting atmosphere. Smart storage solutions, including overhead cabinets, under-counter drawers, and a bench seat with internal storage, ensure everything has its place. The memory foam queen bed, recessed dimmable LED ceiling lights, and swivel passenger and driver seats elevate the living experience, turning Jan Van into a true home on wheels. Safety features such as a carbon monoxide/smoke detector and fire extinguisher provide peace of mind.

Designed for the adventurous spirit, Jan Van is equipped with a roof rack and side ladder, forward-facing light bar, and two FVCO heavy-duty pull-out trays in the garage for additional storage. The Starlink in-motion high-performance kit keeps our customer connected, even in the most remote locations. Whether exploring the wilderness or navigating city streets, Jan Van is the perfect travel companion, ready to embark on unforgettable van life journeys.
